preregistered.question: Does one photon shared by two coset blocks at one common scale read each block at its programmed level, with no crosstalk between the blocks, and does the predecessor's C8 spread (blocks 4, 5 and 6 low, block 7 high) follow the block or the mode slot?
preregistered.inference: descriptive against numeric thresholds; report all detected modes and event denominators
preregistered.levels: level of a slot = 2 x (clicks in its four modes) / (clicks in modes 0..8); the calibrated level divides each slot's dark-subtracted clicks by the slot's efficiency relative to the failure mode (from its anchor reading a, r = a / (2 - a)) before forming the same ratio; a' = (a - a_dark) / (a_anchor - a_dark) with the slot's own anchor and dark is reported beside it

decisions.admission: per-slot anchor (A16 rank 1, ideal level 1 against a kernel partner) and per-slot dark (both blocks in their kernels): bright raw level at least 0.9, dark at most 0.05; early and late anchors within 0.03 and early and late darks within 0.03; sentinel clicks at most 0.05 of every iteration's events; the two null readings within 0.07 of 1/4 and each other; at most 0.1 of the block readings differ between the two slot orientations by more than 0.07. A failure marks the run 'instrument not admitted'.
decisions.conformance: given admission, every T reading within 0.07 of its ideal level and at most floor(0.1 x readings) of the T and F readings farther away
decisions.mutation: given admission, each C and N reading within 0.07 of its mutated ideal level; a reading within the tolerance of the block's true top level instead shows that the readout ignores that sign structure
decisions.crosstalk: given admission, the dark slot beside a bright partner (ideal level at least 0.5) reads at most 0.03 above the slot's own dark reading
decisions.independence: given admission, the calibrated level of the fixed T block ranges at most 0.07 over the partner arms T, C, N and D of its group
decisions.c8_spread: reported whatever the admission: the within-class contrast of the C8 T readings (block 7 minus the mean of blocks 4, 5 and 6), per slot, against contrast_fraction x the predecessor's contrast; both slots at or above it: the spread follows the block; one slot: it follows the mode slot; neither: not reproduced

preregistered.boundary: Conformance of programmed operator blocks to their interference law on one 12-mode mesh with two blocks per photon; the client computes every cd_core sign, so the chip does not compute the algebra, and sim:ascella is noiseless and checks the pipeline only.
